content: Vercel rate limiting on Hobby: in-memory Map counters are instance-isolated and reset across serverless invocations (unreliable alone); Vercel Firewall rate-limit rules available on ALL plans incl Hobby (first 1M allowed rate-limited requests/month included; ~1 custom rule on Hobby; automatic DDoS mitigation every plan); Upstash Redis HTTP-based free tier (~10K commands/day) is the standard serverless-native alternative. Cross-checked Vercel blog/community + Upstash docs/dev.to.
